problem: The approved thesis abstract asks for a controlled comparison of several local language models, but the only model comparisons were router-only (A0-A3 and H6 with llama3.1:8b). The R1b gain could have been a property of qwen2.5:7b. The exploratory R1b loop also stopped after its first configuration because step() in run-improvements.sh assigned the exit status to c, the loop variable.
change: M2 registered before any run (61793a4): R1b's treatment and frozen system plus zero-shot with llama3.1:8b, qwen2.5:1.5b and qwen2.5:14b on the R1b samples, six McNemar tests with Holm. run_m2.py reuses run_r1b.py with --model; analyze_m2.py reuses R1b's prediction rules. run-improvements.sh step() now uses local rc. The thesis gained an M2 section and a conclusion that answers the two research questions separately.
validation: 21 measurement steps, 04:20-08:30Z, live aries.target stopped and restored. 6/6 tests significant after Holm (experiments/thesis-m2-models/summary.json). The thesis build covers 417 ratios with 0 uncovered and passes 82/82 evidence checks.
limitations: A significant test is not a useful agent: qwen2.5:1.5b wins on NL2Bash because its planner fails on every call and every request is refused. Check in-scope accuracy and stage counts before reading a T-vs-F test as success. Prompts were tuned on qwen2.5:7b, there is one repetition, and the labels come from an LLM. A shell function must never assign to a variable name the caller uses; use local.
